description: Create a brand-new multi-platform campaign draft with tailored assets across social, WordPress, Webflow, Ghost, Shopify Blog, Custom Webhook, and Hosted Blog channels (returning contentId, per-channel assetIds, and publishReadiness), with optional immediate publishing (publishNow: true) or Client Review Link. Note: if channels are already configured and the user simply wants to send directly to socials, multiple WordPress websites, Shopify, or other CMS targets without creating a separate draft campaign first, you can call wordflux_publish_now or wordflux_schedule_post directly in one step. When attaching an image across channels, ALWAYS ask the user first if they want to insert the image as-is (autoFormatForPlatforms: false) or also smart-crop it for each channel optimal dimensions (autoFormatForPlatforms: true). Immediately after saving, show the preview + target page names, check publishReadiness, and explicitly tell the user they can publish live right away via wordflux_publish_now(contentId), schedule via wordflux_schedule_post(contentId), or refine in place via wordflux_update_content(contentId).

authorProfileId.description: Optional Author Profile UUID for Hosted Blog attribution

base64Images.description: Optional Base64 or Data URI images for this asset

content.description: Full post or article body copy tailored for this platform (Markdown or HTML supported for blog/CMS; optional when threadPosts is provided)

documentTitle.description: Optional LinkedIn PDF carousel document title

documentUrl.description: Optional HTTPS PDF URL for native swipeable LinkedIn Document Carousels

embedLinkPreview.description: Embed a native link preview card on supported platforms (LinkedIn, Facebook, Bluesky, Threads) when no image or video is attached. Defaults to true.

imageUrl.description: Optional single HTTPS image URL for this asset

imageUrls.description: Optional HTTPS image URLs for this asset

integrationId.description: Optional connected integration UUID from wordflux_list_brands. Use this (or pageName) to target a specific site/account when multiple WordPress websites, Shopify stores, Webflow/Ghost sites, or social accounts are connected to the same brand, or include multiple targets[] entries with different integrationIds to send to several sites at once.

metaDescription.description: Optional SEO meta description / excerpt for CMS or Hosted Blog

openaiFileIdRefs.description: Optional ChatGPT user-uploaded or AI-generated image file references (openaiFileIdRefs) for this asset

pageId.description: Optional destination pageId or CMS collectionId

platform.description: Platform for this asset (linkedin, instagram, threads, google-business, facebook, x, pinterest, bluesky, mastodon, youtube, tiktok, blog, article, wordpress, webflow, ghost, shopify, webhook)

previewUrl.description: Optional URL to use for the native link preview card when no image or video is attached

slug.description: Optional custom URL slug for Hosted Blog or CMS

svgImages.description: Optional SVG XML strings or data:image/svg+xml Data URIs to rasterize into crisp PNGs for this asset

tags.description: Optional SEO tags for CMS or Hosted Blog

threadPosts.description: Optional ordered array of multi-post thread items for X/Twitter, Threads, Bluesky, or Mastodon

title.description: Optional asset title (Pinterest, YouTube, WordPress, Webflow, Ghost, Shopify, Webhook, Hosted Blog)

videoUrl.description: Optional HTTPS MP4/MOV video URL for video social channels

autoFormatForPlatforms.description: Ask the user first: set true to smart focal-crop attached images to each channel optimal aspect ratio (e.g. 4:5/1:1 for Instagram & LinkedIn, 16:9 for Blog/CMS), or false (default) to insert the original image as-is.

createReviewLink.description: Optional: set true to generate a shareable no-login Client Review URL (/review/:token)

embedLinkPreview.description: Embed a native link preview card on supported platforms (LinkedIn, Facebook, Bluesky, Threads) when no image or video is attached. Defaults to true.

linkSocialToCmsPermalink.description: When publishNow is true, publishes the CMS/Hosted Blog asset first and injects its live canonical URL (+ UTM parameters) into social assets

openaiFileIdRefs.description: Array of user-uploaded or AI-generated image files from ChatGPT to persist across campaign assets

previewUrl.description: Optional URL to use for the native link preview card when no image or video is attached

svgImages.description: Optional SVG XML strings or data:image/svg+xml Data URIs to rasterize into PNGs across assets

name: wordflux_create_campaign
